    H_D = entropy(nx0, nx1, n)
    freq_D_F = n11 / n
    H_D_F = entropy(0, n11, n11)
    freq_bar_D_F = (n - n11) / n
    H_D_bar_F = entropy(n00, n01, n0x)

    return value
